title: Apply Power to Tipper Station (Electrical Panel Power Switch)
summary: Turn on electrical power to the tipper station by moving the electrical panel power switch to the "On" position as the first step of tipper commissioning.
when_to_use: Use as the first step when starting tipper commissioning to energize the tipper station before subsequent commissioning steps.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the physical action at the tipper station electrical panel (move the power switch to "On").
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper station electrical panel

access_required: Physical access to the tipper station electrical panel

visual_references.description: Image associated with tipper commissioning step 7.3.23.1 showing the electrical panel power switch and its labeled position.

steps.title: Locate the electrical panel power switch at the tipper station
steps.purpose: Identify the correct electrical panel switch used to energize the tipper station for commissioning.
steps.instruction: Go to the tipper station electrical panel and locate the power switch.
steps.expected_result: You have identified the electrical panel power switch that will be moved to the "On" position.
steps.healthy_condition: The correct power switch is found and is ready to be moved to the "On" position.
steps.failure_condition: The power switch cannot be located or cannot be moved to the "On" position.

actions.label: Find panel power switch
actions.exact_action: Go to the tipper station electrical panel and locate the power switch.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the power switch cannot be moved to "On".

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.23.1: APPLY POWER TO STATION. 1. Turn the power switch on the electrical panel to the "On" position.

steps.title: Turn the electrical panel power switch to "On"
steps.purpose: Energize the tipper station so commissioning can proceed.
steps.instruction: Turn the power switch to the "On" position.
steps.expected_result: The electrical panel power switch is in the "On" position and the station is powered for subsequent commissioning steps.
steps.healthy_condition: The power switch is visibly set to the "On" position.
steps.failure_condition: The power switch cannot be moved to "On" or the panel indicates an abnormal condition that prevents commissioning from proceeding (e.g., no power indication/visible fault).

actions.label: Set switch to On
actions.exact_action: Turn the power switch to the "On" position.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the power switch cannot be moved to "On".
Stop and escalate if the panel indicates an abnormal condition (e.g., no power indication/visible fault) that prevents commissioning from proceeding.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.23.1: APPLY POWER TO STATION. 1. Turn the power switch on the electrical panel to the "On" position.

success_criteria: Electrical panel power switch is in the "On" position.
No abnormal panel indication is present that would prevent proceeding with commissioning.
failure_conditions: Power switch cannot be moved to "On".
Panel indicates an abnormal condition (e.g., no power indication/visible fault) that prevents commissioning from proceeding.
escalation_guidance: If the power switch cannot be moved to "On" or the panel shows an abnormal condition preventing commissioning, stop and escalate.
